#!/usr/bin/env python3
import pexpect
import time

# Test sending various keystrokes
print("Test: Spawning interactive bash...")
child = pexpect.spawn('bash -i', encoding='utf-8', echo=False, timeout=5)

# Test 1: Send regular characters
print("\nTest 1: Sending 'echo test123'...")
child.send('echo test123')
time.sleep(0.1)
child.send('\r')  # Enter key
try:
    child.expect('test123', timeout=2)
    print(f"Success! Output: {child.before}{child.after}")
except pexpect.TIMEOUT:
    print(f"Timeout. Output so far: {child.before}")

# Test 2: Send Ctrl+C
print("\nTest 2: Sending Ctrl+C (\\x03)...")
child.send('\x03')  # Ctrl+C
time.sleep(0.1)

# Test 3: Send Ctrl+D (EOF)
print("\nTest 3: Sending Ctrl+D (\\x04)...")
child.send('\x04')  # Ctrl+D

print("\nTest completed!")
